milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the brick wall structure (centered at spawn-relative [5, 1, 5]) and face toward it, modeling 'player can see the brick wall'. max_distance=10 ensures the player has moved toward the wall (spawn is ~7.4 blocks away, so they need to be within 10 blocks which is easily achievable from spawn while facing it). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the wall.
